items.title: FEnc$^2$: Unifying Data Packing for Efficient Private Inference via Convolution and Architecture-Aware Fragment Encoding
items.summary: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables privacy-preserving machine learning but incurs extreme computational and memory overhead. These costs come not only from expensive low-level primitives, including Number Theoretic Transform (NTT), rotation, and key-switching, but also from inefficient ciphertext packing at the application level. Existing packing strategies typically preserve either neighboring data elements or feature grouping, but not both, leading to wasted ciphertext slots, excessive rotations, and inflated ciphertext counts. We propose FEnc2, a unified and principled fragment-based encoding framework for CKKS-based private convolutional neural network inference. FEnc2 optimizes slot utilization, rotation complexity, and ciphertext density through two components: 1)Conv-aware Encoding, which analytically selects an optimal fragment size to decouple spatial dependencies and jointly minimize inner-outer rotations across layers, and 2)Arch-aware Ct Compression, which restores ciphertext density after feature- or channel-reduction layers. Together, these transformations reshape encrypted workload structure and reduce homomorphic operations by one to two orders of magnitude. With full memory capacity utilized, i.e., at maximum batch size, FEnc2 achieves end-to-end latency speedups over the state-of-the-art Orion of up to 228.83x on GPU and 226.06x on CPU for LeNet on MNIST, and up to 4.55x on GPU and 9.43x on CPU for MobileNet on ImageNet. FEnc2 is hardware-agnostic yet architecturally transformative: by optimizing encrypted tensor layout before execution, it reduces ciphertext count and workload pressure on hardware, complementing primitive-level optimizations such as NTT and keyswitch accelerators. These results show that application-level data layout is a first-order architectural design dimension for encrypted inference and an important enabler for next-generation FHE systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为FEnc²的统一编码框架，用于优化基于CKKS同态加密的私有卷积神经网络推理。全同态加密（FHE）虽能保护隐私，但计算和内存开销极大，部分原因是底层原语（如数论变换NTT、旋转、密钥切换）昂贵，更关键的是应用层面密文打包效率低下。现有打包策略通常仅保留相邻数据元素或特征分组之一，导致密文槽位浪费、旋转操作过多及密文数量膨胀。FEnc²通过两个核心组件解决此问题：1) 卷积感知编码（Conv-aware Encoding）：分析选择最优分片大小，解耦空间依赖，并在各层间联合最小化内外部旋转操作；2) 架构感知密文压缩（Arch-aware Ct Compression）：在特征或通道缩减层后恢复密文密度。这些变换重塑了加密工作负载结构，将同态操作减少一到两个数量级。在最大批处理大小（充分利用内存）下，FEnc²在LeNet/MNIST上相对于最先进系统Orion实现了GPU上高达228.83倍、CPU上226.06倍的端到端延迟加速；在MobileNet/ImageNet上分别达到4.55倍（GPU）和9.43倍（CPU）。FEnc²与硬件无关但具有架构变革性：通过在执行前优化加密张量布局，减少密文数量和对硬件的负载压力，补充了NTT和密钥切换加速器等底层优化。结果表明，应用层的数据布局是加密推理的一级架构设计维度，是下一代FHE系统的重要助推器。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究显著降低了同态加密推理的计算和内存开销，可推动隐私保护机器学习在实际系统中的应用，对安全工程师和密码学研究者具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提升CKKS同态加密推理效率，降低延迟和资源消耗，适用于云端隐私推理、数据外包计算等场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究显著降低了同态加密推理的计算和内存开销，可推动隐私保护机器学习在实际系统中的应用，对安全工程师和密码学研究者具有重要参考价值。

items.title: The Proxy Knows Too Much: Sealing LLM API Routers with Attested TEEs
items.summary: Agents increasingly access large language models (LLMs) through API routers. A router terminates the client's transport-layer security session and opens a separate upstream session, so it holds the full interaction in plaintext. This makes the router an application-layer man-in-the-middle: it can rewrite agent tool calls, swap dependencies for typosquatted packages, trigger attacks only under audit-evading conditions, and passively exfiltrate secrets. Existing client-side defenses are evadable. We propose AEGIS, a provider-transparent attested API router whose data path is a client-verified faithful passthrough. AEGISconfines plaintext handling to a small hardware-enclave component while leaving authentication, scheduling, accounting, and management on the untrusted host. The client verifies the enclave before releasing plaintext. The host can neither read nor alter the interaction, and plaintext leaves only toward destinations fixed by the measured image. We show that all four malicious-router attack classes succeed against a plaintext-access baseline and are blocked by AEGIS, including adaptive tests against the same boundary. The trusted path is $851$ lines, carries three provider-native APIs without conversion, and completes every request under real-provider workload and concurrency. In a seeded audit pilot, two commodity coding agents find eight and ten of ten planted invariant violations. The local relay overhead is about six milliseconds per request.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了大型语言模型（LLM）API 路由器的一个严重安全缺陷：由于路由器终止客户端传输层安全（TLS）会话并建立单独的上游会话，所有交互数据在路由器内部以明文形式暴露。这使得路由器成为应用层中间人，能够篡改代理工具调用、替换依赖为伪装包、在审计回避条件下触发攻击，并被动窃取敏感信息。现有客户端防御措施可被绕过。为此，作者提出了 AEGIS —— 一种对提供商透明的、经认证的 API 路由器，其数据路径是客户端可验证的忠实直通。AEGIS 将明文处理限制在小型硬件飞地（enclave）组件内，而认证、调度、计费和管理等任务仍运行在不可信的主机上。客户端在释放明文前验证飞地，主机既无法读取也无法修改交互内容，明文仅流向由度量镜像固定的目标地址。实验表明，所有四类恶意路由器攻击在明文访问基线中均能成功，而 AEGIS 可完全阻止这些攻击，包括针对同一边界的自适应测试。受信任路径仅包含 851 行代码，支持三种提供商原生 API 而无需转换，在真实提供商负载和并发下完成所有请求。在一项种子审计试点中，两个商用编码代理分别发现了 8 个和 10 个植入的不变违反中的全部。本地中继开销约为每个请求 6 毫秒。该工作为保护 LLM 代理通信提供了实用且高效的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM API 路由器作为中间人可窃取或篡改敏感数据，AEGIS 首次利用 TEE 提供可验证的防护，对代理安全至关重要。

items.title: From Refusal Geometry to Safety Geometry: Harmfulness--Refusal Coupling under Dynamic Adversarial Fine-Tuning
items.summary: Safety alignment requires language models to refuse harmful requests without losing the ability to answer benign ones. Existing robustness evaluations, however, do not reveal whether a model has learned to recognize harmfulness, to activate a refusal policy, or to couple these two processes. We study this question with a dual safety-geometry protocol that measures harmfulness carriers, refusal carriers, and their coupling across aligned instruction-tuned anchors and matched Mistral-7B-v0.1 SFT/R2D2 training trajectories. The aligned anchors validate the protocol: refusal-side interventions reopen attack success more strongly than harmfulness-only interventions, while harmfulness and refusal carriers remain nearly orthogonal. Along the Mistral trajectory, R2D2 exhibits a high-coupling early phase with strong fixed-source robustness, saturated safe-prompt refusal, and collapsed benign utility. Later checkpoints move to a lower-coupling regime with partial utility recovery and reopened attack success. SFT provides an important contrast: it also reaches low coupling, but remains substantially less robust, showing that low coupling alone is not a safety guarantee. All-anchor diagnostics and sparse GCG/AutoDAN transfer experiments further show that H/R coupling is informative in the R2D2 regime, whereas SFT transfer is better summarized by drift or behavior-state measures. Causal sweeps support fixed-protocol sensitivity relative to matched unit-direction controls, but do not establish independent harmfulness and refusal pathways. These results frame harmfulness--refusal coupling as an operational diagnostic for safety-geometry dynamics under adversarial fine-tuning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了语言模型在对抗性微调下的安全对齐内部机制，提出了一种名为“安全性几何”（safety-geometry）的双协议方法，用于测量模型中的“有害性载体”（harmfulness carriers）和“拒绝载体”（refusal carriers）及其耦合程度。作者通过对齐的指令微调锚点（aligned instruction-tuned anchors）和匹配的Mistral-7B-v0.1 SFT/R2D2训练轨迹进行实验。实验结果表明：R2D2早期呈现高耦合状态，此时模型具有强固定的源鲁棒性和安全的提示拒绝能力，但良性能力（benign utility）几乎崩溃；后期进入低耦合状态，良性能力部分恢复，但攻击成功可能性增加。SFT对比显示其同样低耦合，但鲁棒性明显更差，表明低耦合本身不足以保证安全。所有锚点诊断和GCG/AutoDAN迁移实验进一步表明，在R2D2场景下有害性-拒绝耦合（H/R coupling）具有信息量，而SFT迁移更适用漂移或行为状态度量。因果扫描验证了固定协议敏感性，但未确认独立的有害性和拒绝路径。论文将H/R耦合定位为对抗性微调下安全性几何动态的操作诊断工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了模型对抗性微调后安全机制退化的内在原因，为评估和设计更鲁棒的安全对齐方法提供了新的诊断视角。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于RLHF/DPO等安全对齐的LLM在微调场景下的安全性评估方法，可迁移至红蓝对抗、模型审计等场景。

items.title: Dynamic Malicious Skills in Agentic AI
items.summary: Skills are a key enabling component of agentic AI. While they enhance agents' capabilities, they also introduce new attack surfaces. In this work, we investigate one such attack surface by demonstrating dynamic malicious skills. By embedding malicious instructions in natural-language documentation (e.g., SKILL.md), an attacker can induce an agent to dynamically inject malicious logic into an otherwise benign skill during execution. We evaluate this attack across agentic frameworks such as OpenHands and Claude Code, showing that dynamic malicious skills can successfully introduce a range of malicious behaviors at runtime with non-trivial success rates. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose a system-level defense that prevents dynamic modification of skills using operating system kernel-enforced read-only mounts. Our evaluation demonstrates that this defense effectively blocks dynamic malicious skills while preserving the functionality of benign skills.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究了智能体 AI（Agentic AI）中一项关键组件——技能（Skills）所引入的新攻击面。技能通常以自然语言文档（如 SKILL.md）的形式定义，允许智能体在运行时动态加载和执行。作者提出了“动态恶意技能”攻击：攻击者将恶意指令嵌入到技能的文档中，当智能体加载并执行该技能时，会诱使智能体在运行时将恶意逻辑注入到原本良性的技能代码中。这种行为可以绕过静态代码审查和签名验证，因为恶意逻辑并未直接存储在技能文件中，而是通过自然语言描述间接导致智能体生成或修改代码。作者在 OpenHands 和 Claude Code 等主流智能体框架上进行了实验，结果显示该攻击能够以非平凡的成功率实现多种恶意行为，例如信息窃取、命令执行或权限提升。为了防御此类攻击，作者提出了一种系统级防御机制：利用操作系统内核强制只读挂载（read-only mount）来阻止技能在运行时的动态修改。实验表明，该防御在有效阻止动态恶意技能的同时，不会影响良性技能的正常功能。本文的主要贡献在于揭示了 agentic AI 中技能动态性的安全风险，并提出了一种实用的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着 agentic AI 在企业中广泛应用，技能机制可能成为新的侵入入口。本文揭示的攻击手法无需修改代码即可操纵智能体行为，对依赖动态技能的 AI 系统构成直接威胁，相关防御思路值得安全团队借鉴。
defense_advice_zh: 使用操作系统内核级只读挂载限制技能文件的可写性，防止运行时修改
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估自身智能体框架是否涉及动态技能加载，并考虑实施只读挂载防御

items.title: SPARK: Security Knowledge Priming and Representation-Guided Knowledge Activation for LLM-based Secure Code Generation
items.summary: Large language models routinely generate code with exploitable security flaws. Prior literature attributes this limitation to a lack of security expertise, steering current defense mechanisms toward heavy fine-tuning or external knowledge retrieval, which introduces significant computational overhead and data bias through redundant code examples. Contrary to this view, we argue that pretraining corpora are already rich in security material. The bottleneck is activation: without an explicit and brief cue, statistical pressure toward common training-distribution patterns suppresses the model's safety-relevant representations. We present SPARK, an inference-time security harness that activates this latent knowledge without any retraining. The harness has two parts. Component~I retrieves a few of the relevant Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) entries for each coding task and appends a short structured cue to the prompt; this alone is enough to surface the model's existing security representations. Component~II adds a precomputed token bias to the logits at every decoding step. We obtain the bias by projecting a safe-direction vector, the unit difference between the mean safe and mean unsafe last-layer hidden states, through the language model head. The bias is computed once offline; applying it costs a single vector addition per generated token. We evaluate SPARK on 9 open-source models across C++, Java, and Python, and compare with 7 baselines spanning fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented methods. SPARK matches or improves on the best baseline in every setting while preserving HumanEval utility. We further test Component~I in a black-box setting on 7 of today's strongest models, including Claude, DeepSeek, and GPT, demonstrating the bottleneck of insecure code generation and the improvements enabled by our method.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出SPARK（安全知识启动与表示引导的知识激活）方法，用于提升大语言模型（LLM）生成代码的安全性。研究背景是大语言模型常生成带有可被利用安全缺陷的代码。既有文献认为限制源于模型缺乏安全专业知识，因此防御方法依赖大规模微调或外部知识检索，带来显著计算开销和通过冗余代码示例引起的数据偏差。作者反驳这一观点，认为预训练语料本身已富含安全内容，瓶颈在于“激活”：缺乏明确而简洁的提示时，统计压力使模型偏向训练分布中的常见模式，抑制了与安全相关的表征。SPARK是一个推理时的安全插件，无需重训练。它由两部分构成：第一部分（Component I）为每个编码任务检索少量相关CWE条目，并在提示后附加短结构化线索，仅此即可浮现模型已有的安全表征；第二部分（Component II）在每一步解码时向logits添加预计算的令牌偏置（token bias）。该偏置通过将安全方向向量（平均安全与平均不安全的最后一层隐藏状态的单位差）经语言模型头投影得到。偏置离线计算一次，应用时每个生成令牌仅需一次向量加法。作者在C++、Java、Python中评估了9个开源模型，并与7个基线（涵盖微调和检索增强方法）进行比较。SPARK在所有设置中匹配或超越最佳基线，同时保持HumanEval工具指标不变。此外，Component I在黑盒设置下对7个最强模型（包括Claude、DeepSeek和GPT）进行了测试，证实了不安全代码生成的瓶颈以及该方法带来的改进。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SPARK以极低推理开销显著提升LLM生成代码的安全性，无需重训练，可即插即用于现有模型，为安全代码生成提供了高效实用的新范式。

items.why_it_matters: SPARK以极低推理开销显著提升LLM生成代码的安全性，无需重训练，可即插即用于现有模型，为安全代码生成提供了高效实用的新范式。

items.title: did:crdt: Coordination-Free Decentralised Identifiers via Signed CRDTs
items.summary: Existing Decentralised Identifier (DID) methods require coordination, an agreed global order of operations, to update a DID document: blockchain-anchored methods incur fees and latency; lightweight peer methods (did:key, did:peer) offer no update mechanism; and Sidetree methods still require blockchain ordering for finality. We present did:crdt, a DID method that targets W3C DID Core and removes the need for coordination entirely: there is no ledger, no sequencer, and no global total order. Each DID document is composed of signed Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), one per document field, each chosen so that concurrent edits merge deterministically. By the CALM Theorem, the state-merge path is then confluent: replicas that see the same updates reach the same document in any arrival order. The signed-delta path needs only causal delivery, applying an update after those it builds on, which is far weaker than the total ordering ledgers impose and needs no agreement protocol. We are explicit about scope: every untrusted-peer path is authenticated, so Byzantine fault tolerance (safety even when peers lie or send malformed data) holds for signed deltas and verified-bundle replay, while the unauthenticated state-merge path is a trusted-domain optimisation and key-compromise recovery is bounded by revocation semantics. We give the data and threat model, CRUD semantics, conflict resolution, and a Rust reference implementation with property-based convergence tests and microsecond-scale merge latency.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 did:crdt 的全新去中心化标识符（DID）方法，旨在消除现有 DID 方案中必需的协调过程。现有方法如基于区块链的 DID 需要全局排序，导致费用和延迟；轻量级方案如 did:key 和 did:peer 无法更新文档；Sidetree 等方法仍需区块链提供最终性。did:crdt 利用带符号的冲突自由复制数据类型（CRDT）来构建 DID 文档：每个文档字段对应一个独立的 CRDT，从而允许并发编辑并确定性合并。根据 CALM 定理，状态合并路径是流收敛的，即副本看到相同更新集后无论顺序如何都能达到一致文档；签名增量路径仅需因果传递，弱于全序且无需共识协议。论文详细阐述了数据与威胁模型、CRUD 语义、冲突解决策略，并提供了 Rust 参考实现，包括基于属性的收敛测试和微秒级合并延迟。安全方面，所有不可信对等路径经过认证，签名增量和验证包重放具备拜占庭容错，而未认证的状态合并路径作为可信域优化，密钥泄露恢复受撤销语义约束。该研究适用于分布式系统、去中心化身份和抗审查应用领域的研究人员。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 去中心化身份是 Web3 和自托管基础设施的核心组件，现有方案依赖全局排序或无法更新。did:crdt 无需区块链或共识即可实现可更新的 DID，降低成本和延迟，同时提供明确的拜占庭容错保证，对构建轻量级、离线的身份系统具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Scalable Malware Family Classification Using Quantum Kernel Based Machine Learning
items.summary: The classification of malware families is a key challenge in cybersecurity, which enables threat attribution, analysis of attack operations, and the formulation of effective defense strategies. Emerging malware samples are becoming increasingly structurally similar and obfuscated, making accurate multiclass classification challenging for traditional machine learning models, especially when deployed at scale. In this research, we propose a scalable Quantum Kernel-based Machine Learning (QKML) framework for malware family classification that addresses both accuracy and efficiency constraints. The proposed framework extracts structural features from executable files and uses a supervised Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) projection to generate a compact, class-aware representation well suited for quantum processing. The nonlinear relationships among malware families are captured using a fidelity-based quantum kernel built from parameterized quantum circuits. We use the Nyström approximation method to obtain a low-rank approximation of the quantum kernel, which enables effective multiclass classification via ridge regression and enables learning from all available training samples without incurring the quadratic computational cost of kernel matrix construction. The proposed model achieves strong classification performance, with 80.88% accuracy, outperforming classical machine learning baselines under identical feature and data splits, according to experimental evaluation on a large-scale malware dataset that includes 18,836 samples across 23 malware families. These findings suggest that scalable quantum-kernel-based machine learning can offer measurable performance advantages for real-world malware family classification tasks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于量子核的机器学习（QKML）框架，用于解决大规模恶意软件家族分类问题。传统机器学习模型在处理结构相似且经过混淆的恶意软件样本时，多类分类精度和可扩展性不足。框架首先从可执行文件中提取结构特征，然后通过监督线性判别分析（LDA）投影生成紧凑的、类别感知的表示，适合量子处理。随后，利用参数化量子电路构建基于保真度的量子核，以捕获恶意软件家族之间的非线性关系。通过Nyström近似方法获得量子核的低秩近似，从而使用岭回归实现高效的多类分类，避免了核矩阵构建的二次计算成本。实验基于包含18,836个样本、涵盖23个恶意软件家族的大规模数据集，所提模型达到80.88%的准确率，在相同特征和数据划分下优于经典机器学习基线。结果表明，可扩展的量子核机器学习可在实际恶意软件家族分类任务中提供可衡量的性能优势。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量子机器学习在网络安全领域的应用尚处于早期，该工作展示了量子核方法在恶意软件分类中的实用性和可扩展性，为未来的量子增强安全分析提供了实证依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可部署于安全运营中心（SOC）的恶意软件分析流水线，提升大规模样本的家族归属准确性，尤其适用于新型变种的快速检测。

items.why_it_matters: 量子机器学习在网络安全领域的应用尚处于早期，该工作展示了量子核方法在恶意软件分类中的实用性和可扩展性，为未来的量子增强安全分析提供了实证依据。

items.title: obliv-clang: Real-World Oblivious Programming in C++
items.summary: Side-channel vulnerabilities, particularly timing and access-pattern-based attacks, have become critical issues for confidential data processing in trusted environments. Oblivious programming is an effective approach to alleviate these attacks by making program execution not leak any secret through execution time and data access traces. To facilitate oblivious programming in practice, we propose a compilation-time checking tool, obliv-clang, which can comprehensively check the obliviousness of a program written in C++. It is designed to support the rich language features in C++, including the complicated concept of arbitrarily nested pointers, in order to seamlessly work with existing industry-level codebases and produce high-performance compiled binaries with minimum compilation overheads. We design a set of rules in obliv-clang and formally prove their soundness in the presence of complicated C++ language features. We also implement several non-trivial oblivious algorithms as case studies to demonstrate the expressiveness of obliv-clang, and show that programs compiled using obliv-clang can outperform previous solutions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 obliv-clang，一个编译时检查工具，用于在 C++ 程序中实现 oblivious 编程，从而缓解时序和访问模式侧信道攻击。文章首先指出在可信执行环境（TEE）中处理机密数据时，侧信道攻击已成为关键安全问题。Oblivious 编程通过确保程序执行不通过执行时间和数据访问轨迹泄露秘密，是一种有效的防御方法。然而，现有方案难以支持 C++ 的丰富语言特性（如任意嵌套指针），且无法无缝集成到现有工业级代码库。为此，作者设计了一套规则，并形式化证明了它们在复杂 C++ 语言特性下的正确性。obliv-clang 能够全面检查 C++ 程序的 obliviousness，生成高性能编译二进制文件，且编译开销极低。通过多个非平凡 oblivious 算法（如安全数据排序、矩阵乘法等）的案例研究，展示了其表达能力。实验表明，使用 obliv-clang 编译的程序比先前解决方案具有更好的性能。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: obliv-clang 首次实现了对 C++ 完整语言特性（包括嵌套指针）的编译时 obliviousness 检查，填补了工程化空白，能帮助开发者编写侧信道安全的代码，尤其适用于云环境中的机密计算。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何需要防止时序和访问模式侧信道攻击的 C++ 代码开发场景，特别是使用 TEE（如 Intel SGX）的机密计算、密码库实现、可信数据聚合等。

items.why_it_matters: obliv-clang 首次实现了对 C++ 完整语言特性（包括嵌套指针）的编译时 obliviousness 检查，填补了工程化空白，能帮助开发者编写侧信道安全的代码，尤其适用于云环境中的机密计算。

items.title: Invisible Manipulation Channels in AI-Assisted Financial Advisory: Implications for Market Integrity and Regulatory Design
items.summary: AI systems are increasingly deployed for credit assessment and investment advisory in global financial markets, yet the integrity of their inference pipelines remains insufficiently addressed by existing regulatory frameworks. This paper identifies and empirically validates an invisible manipulation channel operating at the sampling layer of LLM inference--a vulnerability that allows adversaries to systematically bias AI-generated financial opinions while preserving full compliance with output-based audit mechanisms, including statistical watermarking. We show that this inference-stage manipulation is statistically hard to detect: the Kullback-Leibler divergence between manipulated and normal output distributions can be made arbitrarily small, so that any output-based detection scheme requires impractically large sample sizes to achieve reliable detection power. Empirical experiments across credit rating and investment advisory scenarios show that directional bias keywords can be amplified by 1.8-1.9x under stealth-preserving (aware) manipulation while triggering zero of six black-box detectors and preserving watermark integrity. The vulnerability generalizes across three mainstream watermarking schemes and three heterogeneous model architectures, establishing it as a systemic financial infrastructure risk. Software-based defenses including cryptographically secure pseudorandom number generators are entirely ineffective, while QRNG combined with TEE hardware isolation achieves 100% attack blocking--reducing the target rate to the natural baseline--by replacing the predictable hash key with quantum-derived entropy that renders all pre-computed manipulation targets invalid. We propose four regulatory amendments centered on mandatory QRNG certification for high-risk financial AI systems under NIST SP 800-90B, inference-layer supply chain audits, and output provenance mechanisms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了AI辅助金融咨询系统中存在的一种新型隐形操纵通道。该攻击发生在LLM推理的采样层，攻击者通过操纵随机数生成过程，在保持输出分布统计特性不变的前提下，系统性偏置模型生成的金融意见（如信用评级、投资建议），同时绕过所有基于输出的审计机制（包括统计水印）。作者通过理论分析和实验验证，证明该操纵的KL散度可以任意小，使得任何基于输出的检测方案都需要不切实际的大样本量才能可靠检测。在信用评级和投资咨询场景的实验中，隐蔽操纵可将方向性偏见关键词放大1.8-1.9倍，同时触发零个黑盒检测器并保持水印完整性。该漏洞在三种主流水印方案和三种异构模型架构上普遍存在，表明这是一个系统性的金融基础设施风险。软件防御（如密码学安全伪随机数生成器）完全无效，而结合量子随机数生成器（QRNG）与可信执行环境（TEE）硬件隔离可实现100%攻击阻断，将目标率降至自然基线。最后，作者提出四项监管修正建议，包括对高风险金融AI系统强制要求QRNG认证（依据NIST SP 800-90B）、推理层供应链审计和输出溯源机制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了一种针对AI金融咨询系统的新攻击面，攻击者可在不触发任何现有检测机制的情况下系统性地偏置模型输出，对市场诚信和投资者保护构成严重威胁。

items.title: Your "Pro" LLM Subscription May Actually Be "Free": Exposing Fingerprint Spoofing Risks in LLM Inference Services
items.summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) APIs become ubiquitous, users increasingly rely on black-box fingerprinting to verify that providers are serving the advertised premium models. However, these methods may overlook adversarial providers who manipulate model weights to cheat the fingerprint process. We introduce a novel threat termed fingerprint spoofing, where a malicious provider stealthily serves a weaker model that has been parameter-efficiently fine-tuned to mimic a stronger model, thereby evading user-side fingerprinting. We first formally prove that user-side resource constraints (i.e., finite query budgets and weak fingerprinting classifiers) make current fingerprinting vulnerable to fingerprint spoofing. Guided by this theoretical analysis, we propose GhostPrint, a cost-effective attack framework leveraging surrogate modeling, reward-ranked fine-tuning, and knowledge distillation. Extensive evaluations in both static and continual fingerprinting settings demonstrate that GhostPrint allows weak models to consistently bypass representative fingerprint methods while maintaining utility at a low fine-tuning cost, exposing a critical vulnerability in current LLM fingerprinting pipelines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）API的普及使得用户越来越依赖黑盒指纹识别技术来验证服务商是否提供了所宣传的优质模型。然而，这些方法可能忽略对抗性服务商操纵模型权重以欺骗指纹识别过程的风险。本文首次提出了一种名为“指纹欺骗”的新型威胁：恶意服务商偷偷部署一个参数高效微调过的弱模型，使其模仿强模型的行为，从而逃避用户端的指纹检测。作者首先从理论上证明了用户端资源约束（即有限的查询预算和弱指纹分类器）使得现有指纹识别易受欺骗攻击。基于这一理论分析，他们提出了GhostPrint攻击框架，该框架利用代理模型、基于奖励的微调和知识蒸馏技术，以低成本实现有效的欺骗。在静态和持续指纹识别两种设置下的广泛评估表明，GhostPrint能够使弱模型持续绕过具有代表性的指纹检测方法，同时以较低的微调成本保持模型实用性。该工作揭示了当前LLM指纹识别流程中的一个关键漏洞。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM服务中指纹验证的盲点，即恶意服务商可通过低成本的参数微调冒充高端模型，严重损害用户信任与交易公平性。安全从业者需关注此类新型欺骗攻击，重新评估现有验证手段的可靠性。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估指纹欺骗对自身LLM服务验证流程的潜在影响。

items.title: MASCOT-Android: A Curated Dataset and Automated Collection Pipeline for Android Malware Source Code Specimens
items.summary: Compared with binaries and decompiled code, malware source code more directly reflects the attackers' original intent. However, the scarcity of source code and the high cost of manual review make such datasets difficult to build and maintain. We propose MASCOT-Android, a curated dataset of Android malware source code and an automated collection framework for scalable malware source code discovery on GitHub. A key finding of our work is that repository-level documentation alone provides a strong signal for malware source code collection. Our model extracts character-level TF-IDF features from 8,772 malware and 25,747 benign README documents and trains a LinearSVC classifier to distinguish malware repositories. This README-only model achieves an accuracy of 96.28\% and an FPR of 1.06\% in local evaluation. In addition, the model outputs confidence scores, allowing users to adjust the decision threshold to balance FPR and coverage, which is practical in real-world malware source code collection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 安卓恶意软件源代码稀缺，现有数据集多基于二进制或反编译代码，难以直接反映攻击者意图。本文提出MASCOT-Android，一个精心整理的安卓恶意软件源代码数据集，并构建了自动化收集管道，用于从GitHub中规模化发现恶意软件源码。研究发现，仓库级文档（README）本身即可作为强信号来区分恶意与良性仓库。作者从8,772个恶意和25,747个良性README文档中提取字符级TF-IDF特征，训练LinearSVC分类器。该仅基于README的模型在本地评估中达到96.28%的准确率和1.06%的假阳性率，且能够输出置信度分数，便于用户根据实际需求调整决策阈值以平衡漏报与覆盖。该工作为恶意软件源码研究提供了高质量数据集和可扩展的收集方法，适合安全研究人员、恶意软件分析人员及数据科学从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了首个大规模、可扩展的安卓恶意软件源代码数据集，并证明了README文档作为恶意软件检测信号的有效性，有助于推动基于源码的恶意软件分析与研究。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于威胁情报中的恶意软件溯源、特征提取，以及自动化恶意软件变种发现场景。

items.why_it_matters: 提供了首个大规模、可扩展的安卓恶意软件源代码数据集，并证明了README文档作为恶意软件检测信号的有效性，有助于推动基于源码的恶意软件分析与研究。

items.title: The Anatomy of Scam Scenarios: Large-Scale Characterization and Conversation-Aware Detection
items.summary: Online scams have become a pervasive global threat, causing substantial financial, psychological, and operational harm. Scammers embed psychological techniques (PTs) within reusable operational schemes to scale scam campaigns with minimal adaptation. However, existing studies often analyze PTs as isolated features, overlooking the recurring scam scenarios in which they are systematically deployed. To address this gap, we first conduct a large-scale empirical study to jointly characterize scam scenarios and their associated PTs. Specifically, we develop a data-driven pipeline to derive a hierarchical taxonomy of scam scenarios, consisting of 18 fine-grained scenarios grouped into 6 high-level tactics based on their PT profiles. Furthermore, to transfer this scenario-level knowledge to practical defense, we design a conversation-aware scam scenario detection approach for financial-institution customer interactions, enabling timely warning and intervention. Our study on 102,054 real-world scam incident reports, spanning 2024-02-01 to 2025-10-31, reveals that PT usage is significantly associated with scam scenarios. We further show that scammers organize scenarios around different operational goals, such as broad victim exposure, high victim conversion, and high-value extraction, and reuse infrastructure, including IP addresses, domains, email addresses, and phone numbers, to launch coordinated campaigns at scale. llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对在线诈骗中系统性使用的心理技术（PT）和可复用的操作模式进行了大规模实证研究。研究者首先收集了 102,054 份真实诈骗事件报告（时间跨度为 2024 年 2 月至 2025 年 10 月），开发了一套数据驱动管道，从诈骗描述中提取心理技术和场景特征，构建了一个分层诈骗场景分类体系，包含 18 个细粒度场景和 6 个高层战术。研究发现，不同的心理技术组合与特定的诈骗场景显著相关，且诈骗者围绕不同的运营目标（如广泛接触受害者、提高转化率、高价值提取）组织场景，并复用 IP 地址、域名、电子邮件和电话号码等基础设施发动大规模协调攻击。此外，论文设计了一种面向金融机构客户交互的对话感知诈骗场景检测方法，能够实现对诈骗行为的及时预警和干预。该方法将对话上下文纳入分析，识别正在发生的诈骗场景，从而触发防御措施。实验结果表明，该检测方法在真实数据集上具有有效性。本文贡献包括：首次对诈骗场景和心理技术进行联合大规模刻画；构建了层次化的场景分类体系；提出了可部署的对话感知检测方案。适合安全分析师、反欺诈工程师和金融机构风控人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 在线诈骗每年造成巨大损失，现有研究多孤立分析心理技术，缺乏对完整诈骗场景的刻画。本文首次大规模联合分析场景与心理技术，并提出可部署的对话感知检测方法，有助于金融机构提升实时反诈骗能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至银行、支付平台等客服对话场景，用于实时识别诈骗会话，降低用户被骗风险。同时为诈骗模式研究和威胁情报提供新的分析维度。

items.title: New Ideas on a New Old Type of Cipher:The Mixed-Radix One-Time Pad
items.summary: In a short 2012 preprint, an unconventional cipher was introduced, now in this note we take that representational core, formalize it, and use it as the basis for a clean generalization of the one-time pad to non-uniform bases, which we call the Mixed-Radix One-Time Pad (MR-OTP). And we prove that the MR-OTP achieves Shannon perfect secrecy, show that the classical binary OTP is exactly the all-bases-equal-2 special case, and that fixed-base variants recover OTPs over arbitrary alphabets. We then examine whether secret bases can lower the key entropy required for perfect secrecy (they cannot). We close with a usable session protocol based on key rolling that preserves perfect secrecy, and with an honest account of the open problems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为混合基数一次性密码本（MR-OTP）的新型密码原语，它是经典二进制一次性密码本（OTP）在非均匀基上的推广。研究基于2012年一篇短预印本中的非传统密码表示核心，作者将其形式化并扩展为通用框架。核心思想是：明文符号可以来自不同基数的字符集（例如，混合使用十进制数字、字母等），密钥则以对应的混合基数形式随机生成。通过严格证明，MR-OTP保留了香农完美保密性：密文与明文统计独立，即使攻击者拥有无限计算能力也无法破解。论文进一步展示了经典二进制OTP（所有基数均为2）和固定基数变种（任意字母表上的OTP）都是MR-OTP的特例。此外，作者探讨了是否可以通过保密基数来降低完美保密所需的密钥熵——结论是否定的，密钥熵必须等于明文熵。最后，论文提出了一个基于密钥滚动的实用会话协议，该协议在每次通信后更新密钥，同时保持完美保密性。文章末尾诚实地列出了若干开放问题，例如如何在实际系统中高效生成与明文熵匹配的混合基数密钥。本文适合密码学理论研究者、安全协议设计者以及对信息论安全（而非计算安全）感兴趣的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MR-OTP将经典一次性密码本推广到混合基数场景，填补了非均匀明文空间的理论空白，为需要完美保密性且明文含多种字符类型的特殊应用提供了可证明安全的基础。

items.title: Stickel-type key exchange with hidden subspaces
items.summary: We give a witness-finding cryptanalysis of Stickel-type key exchange schemes, which involve two-sided multiplication of $n \times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_p$, where these matrices are drawn from public subspaces with a particular commuting structure. This analysis covers Stickel's original proposal , Shpilrain's polynomial extension of that scheme, Nager's algebraic extension of that scheme, and more generally all Stickel-type approaches using public subspaces over matrix algebra in finite fields: all such schemes can be broken in polynomial time. We also describe a new key establishment scheme using two-sided matrix multiplication in which the commuting subspaces used to form the key are hidden via conjugation by private terms, blocking this specific public-subspace analysis; the witness-finding problem in this new scheme has a direct reduction from a standard NP-hard problem (Edmonds' problem).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对Stickel类型的密钥交换方案进行了witness-finding密码分析，这类方案涉及在有限域F_p上的n×n矩阵的双侧乘法，且矩阵选自具有特定交换结构的公共子空间。分析覆盖了Stickel原始方案、Shpilrain的多项式扩展、Nager的代数扩展，以及更一般的所有使用有限域上矩阵代数中公共子空间的Stickel类型方法。研究表明，所有这些方案都可以在多项式时间内被破解。针对这一弱点，本文提出了一种新的密钥建立方案，同样基于双侧矩阵乘法，但通过私密项共轭隐藏了用于生成密钥的交换子空间，从而阻断了上述针对公共子空间的分析。该新方案中的witness-finding问题可直接归约到标准NP难问题（Edmonds问题），提供了安全性证明。该工作对基于矩阵的密钥交换领域的密码分析及设计均有重要贡献。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文证明了大量现有Stickel型密钥交换方案存在根本性安全缺陷，可被多项式时间破解，同时提出了一种基于隐藏子空间的新方案并证明其困难性归约，对后量子密码协议设计具有指导意义。

items.title: SkillVetBench: LLM-as-Judge for Multi-Dimensional Security Risk Evaluation in Open-Source LLM Agent Skills
items.summary: Open-source LLM agent ecosystems are growing rapidly, yet the security of community-contributed skills - modular tool definitions that extend agent capabilities - remains largely unvetted. The gap we fill: existing scanners operate at the code layer and are structurally blind to instruction-layer and multi-agent risk - natural-language directives that hijack an agent, exfiltrate data through encoded side channels, or chain harm across pipelines - so what is needed is a semantic, multi-dimensional vetting system rather than another signature matcher. We present SKILLVETBENCH, a live public leaderboard on Hugging Face that uses an LLM-as-Judge to vet agent skills. What is new: SARS (Skill Agentic Risk Score), a five-dimensional agentic-risk metric with a principled weighted formula for instruction-following systems. What is integrated: full CVSS v4.0 vector decomposition and a ClawHub dual-view that places our LLM-generated review beside the official marketplace verdict. What is demonstrated: drawing on our companion benchmark paper [ 1], the LLM-as-Judge stage achieves zero false negatives across 78 confirmed-malicious skills and zero false positives across 22 benign controls, while the best static baseline (SKILLSIEVE) still misses 15%; for instruction-layer categories such as Prompt Injection and Memory Poisoning, conventional tools miss between 89% and 100% of threats (e.g., CODEBERT detects none of nine memory-poisoning skills). Detection rates vary from 35% to 95% across four LLM evaluators, motivating ensemble scoring in production deployments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 SkillVetBench，一个面向开源 LLM 代理生态系统中社区贡献技能（skill）的安全评估基准与实时排行榜。现有安全扫描工具主要基于代码层静态分析，无法检测指令层（如提示注入、记忆投毒）和多代理协同风险。SkillVetBench 采用 LLM-as-Judge 方法，利用大语言模型作为裁判，对技能进行多维度安全评估。其核心创新包括：1）SARS（技能代理风险评分），一个基于加权公式的五维代理风险度量；2）集成 CVSS v4.0 向量分解，将安全评估标准化；3）ClawHub 双视图，将 LLM 生成的评估意见与官方市场审核结果并排展示。实验表明，在 78 个确认恶意技能和 22 个良性技能的测试集上，LLM-as-Judge 阶段实现了零假阴性和零假阳性，而最佳静态基线方法 SKILLSIEVE 仍漏检 15%。对于指令层威胁（如提示注入、记忆投毒），传统工具漏检率高达 89%–100%（如 CODEBERT 无法检测任何记忆投毒技能）。四种不同 LLM 评估器在检测率上从 35% 到 95% 不等，提示生产环境应采用集成评分。该工作为 LLM 代理技能的安全审查提供了新范式，适合安全研究员、AI 开发者及平台运营者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着开源 LLM 代理生态快速扩张，社区贡献技能的安全审查严重缺失。SkillVetBench 首次系统化解决指令层和多代理风险，其零误报/零漏检的 LLM-as-Judge 方案可能成为下一代技能安全评估标准，对防范智能体劫持、数据泄露等攻击至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响开源 LLM 代理平台（如 Hugging Face）的技能审核流程；可迁移至企业内部 LLM 应用安全评估、插件商店安全审查等场景。

items.title: AIChilles: Automatically Uncovering Hidden Weaknesses in AI-Evolved Systems
items.summary: The computer systems community has recently seen growing interest in AI-driven system evolution, where AI agents iteratively rewrite systems. Frameworks such as AdaEvolve and Engram report 12-60% score improvements over human-designed algorithms. While these results are promising, there are practical concerns if these AI-evolved programs can perform worse on unseen workloads and exhibit scalability regressions. Given the speed and scale of AI-generated code, we need automated mechanisms to uncover such identify hidden weaknesses in AI-evolved systems programs. To this end, we develop AIChilles that takes as input a baseline program $P$ and an AI-evolved program $P'$, AIChilles searches for valid workloads where $P'$ regresses relative to $P$ in correctness, runtime, memory usage, or output quality. To tackle the diversity in system applications, weakness types and potential bugs, AIChilles combines deterministic workload-parameter extraction, agent-based constraint inference, differential oracles, and code-frequency coverage to discover diverse failures. Across five system applications and 30 AI-evolved programs, AIChilles finds 49 distinct hidden weaknesses. We also show that explicitly including AIChilles in the AI-driven development lifecycle can mitigate several of these weaknesses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注AI驱动系统演化（即使用AI智能体迭代重写系统程序）中可能产生的隐藏弱点。现有框架如AdaEvolve和Engram声称能在多种任务上超越人类设计的算法达12-60%，但这些AI演化程序在未见工作负载下可能出现性能退化、可扩展性问题或正确性缺陷。为此，作者开发了AIChilles工具，以基准程序P和AI演化版本P'为输入，自动搜索导致P'在正确性、运行时、内存消耗或输出质量方面相比P退化的有效工作负载。AIChilles结合确定性工作负载参数提取、基于智能体的约束推理、差异预言机以及代码频率覆盖等技术，以应对系统应用的多样性、弱点类型和潜在错误。在五个系统应用和30个AI演化程序上，AIChilles发现了49个不同的隐藏弱点。实验还表明，将AIChilles纳入AI驱动的开发生命周期可缓解部分弱点。该工作揭示了AI自动编程在系统领域的安全隐患，并为评估和提升AI演化程序的鲁棒性提供了自动化手段。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI自动生成代码日益普及，但其潜在缺陷难以通过传统测试发现。AIChilles首次系统性地揭露AI演化程序在多种维度的退化风险，为安全评估和开发流程改进提供关键工具。

items.title: TrustedARI: Towards Trust-Native Agentic Routing Infrastructure for Agentic AI
items.summary: AI agents increasingly access external models, tools, and services through Agentic Routing Infrastructure (ARI) to manage the overhead of heterogeneous interfaces and fragmented subscriptions. Yet, the architecture of ARI introduces fundamental trust risks: it obtains plaintext access to agent queries and service responses, while leaving agents unable to verify that their queries are routed to intended service providers or that requests and responses remain untampered. To address this problem, we present TrustedARI, the first trust-native agentic routing infrastructure for agentic AI. Architecturally, TrustedARI is built upon three core innovations: (i) an ARI-adapted three-party TLS handshake that enables the agent and ARI to jointly authenticate the service provider through role-specific distribution of TLS key materials; (ii) a privacy-preserving query-construction protocol that allows the agent and ARI to collaboratively construct well-formed queries without exposing their respective private inputs; and (iii) a verifiable billing protocol that supports fair usage-based settlement while preserving the integrity and confidentiality of service responses. We implemented and extensively evaluated a prototype of TrustedARI to validate its performance. Experiments confirm that TrustedARI is highly efficient: our ARI-adapted handshake protocol reduces communication overhead by 39.34% compared to the existing three-party TLS handshake. Furthermore, the privacy-preserving query-construction protocol imposes negligible overhead-averaging 0.19 seconds in computation time and 0.58 MB in communication costs-while the verifiable billing protocol speeds up proof generation by 28.20x. Crucially, TrustedARI is readily deployable without any modification to the service providers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着AI智能体（Agent）通过Agentic路由基础设施（ARI）访问外部模型、工具和服务以管理异构接口和碎片化订阅，ARI架构引入了根本性的信任风险：它能够以明文方式获取智能体查询和服务响应，同时智能体无法验证其查询是否被路由到预期的服务提供商，也无法确保请求和响应未被篡改。针对这一问题，本文提出了TrustedARI，这是首个针对智能体AI的信任原生路由基础设施。TrustedARI的架构建立在三个核心创新之上：（1）一种适配ARI的三方TLS握手协议，通过角色特定的TLS密钥材料分发，使智能体和ARI能够共同认证服务提供商；（2）一种隐私保护的查询构建协议，允许智能体和ARI在不暴露各自私有输入的情况下协作构建格式正确的查询；（3）一种可验证的计费协议，支持基于使用量的公平结算，同时保证服务响应的完整性和机密性。研究人员实现了TrustedARI的原型并进行了广泛评估，实验表明其高效性：与现有的三方TLS握手相比，ARI适配握手协议将通信开销降低了39.34%；隐私保护查询构建协议带来的开销可以忽略不计——平均计算时间仅为0.19秒，通信成本仅为0.58 MB；可验证计费协议将证明生成速度提升了28.20倍。重要的是，TrustedARI无需对服务提供商进行任何修改即可部署。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前ARI架构中智能体查询与响应的明文暴露及路由篡改风险，并提供了可直接部署的信任增强方案，对保障AI agent生态中的通信安全与隐私具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 若被采用，可从根本上改变AI agent与外部服务交互的安全模型，适用于多智能体协作、工具调用、联邦学习等场景。

items.title: FuseChain: Runtime Evidence Reconstruction for Software Supply-Chain Attacks
items.summary: Software supply-chain (SSC) attacks are increasingly multi-stage, cross-source, and temporally distributed. A single attack campaign may leave weak and fragmented traces across multi-source telemetry that captures different granularities and perspectives of runtime behavior. Existing runtime detection systems often analyze these sources independently, making it difficult to identify low-frequency attack evidence or reconstruct the temporal context in which it appears. We present FUSECHAIN, a runtime detection framework that represents multi-source software supply-chain telemetry as a temporal heterogeneous provenance graph over a unified event-time axis. By aligning package/runtime traces, process events, network telemetry, DNS/HTTP metadata, and security alerts on a unified temporal graph, FuseChain captures cross-source dependencies and sparse attack evidence that may be ambiguous within any individual source. It learns anomaly-centric temporal representations from benign-prefix telemetry and performs deployable attack-stage reconstruction through a lightweight decoder on top of a frozen anomaly backbone. Our experiments show that jointly optimizing anomaly detection and stage prediction is ineffective under sparse and imbalanced runtime supply-chain telemetry. Across seven SSC attack scenarios, FuseChain improves deployable stage reconstruction from 0.369 to 0.881 Stage Recall@500 with a frozen-backbone decoder, while adaptive retrieval further increases observable-stage recall from 0.524 to 0.655 without modifying the detector. These results highlight the deployable value of decoupling runtime SSC anomaly detection from downstream attack-stage interpretation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 FuseChain，一种针对软件供应链攻击的运行时检测框架。软件供应链攻击日益呈现多阶段、跨源和时间分散的特点，攻击痕迹往往分散在不同粒度和视角的多源遥测（如包/运行时跟踪、进程事件、网络遥测、DNS/HTTP 元数据、安全告警）中。现有检测系统通常独立分析各源，难以关联低频攻击证据或重建攻击的时间上下文。FuseChain 通过将多源遥测对齐到统一的事件时间轴，构建时序异构图（temporal heterogeneous provenance graph），从而捕获跨源依赖和单源模糊的稀疏攻击证据。它从良性前缀遥测中学习以异常为中心的时间表征，并在冻结的异常检测骨干之上使用轻量解码器实现可部署的攻击阶段重建。实验表明，在稀疏且不平衡的运行时供应链遥测下，联合优化异常检测和阶段预测效果不佳；而解耦策略显著提升了阶段重建性能。在 7 个 SSC 攻击场景上，FuseChain 将部署阶段重建的 Stage Recall@500 从 0.369 提升至 0.881，同时自适应检索在不修改检测器的情况下将可观测阶段召回率从 0.524 提升至 0.655。该工作突出展示了将运行时 SSC 异常检测与下游攻击阶段解释解耦的部署价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了软件供应链攻击检测中多源数据关联困难、攻击阶段重建不准确的痛点，提出的解耦检测与解释的实用框架有望提升 SOC 对复杂攻击链的追踪能力。

items.title: Let Them Steal: Trapping Large Language Model Extraction Attacks with Knowledge Honeypot
items.summary: Large language models deployed as commercial APIs are vulnerable to model extraction attacks, while existing defenses either act too late or degrade utility for legitimate users. We propose \textbf{Knowledge Trap}, a defense that redirects extraction attacks toward low-transferability knowledge through a \emph{Honeypot Knowledge Graph} (HKG) and breadcrumb-guided exploration. Instead of blocking queries or perturbing outputs, Knowledge Trap consumes the attacker's limited query budget on knowledge with negligible downstream utility while preserving benign-user performance. Experiments in medical and financial domains show that Knowledge Trap reduces surrogate Agreement by 6.2\% on average without degrading legitimate-user accuracy, outperforming existing defenses that impose measurable user impact. These results suggest that defending knowledge-space traversal is a practical direction for mitigating LLM extraction attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为“Knowledge Trap”的新型防御方法，用于保护作为商业API部署的大型语言模型（LLM）免受模型提取攻击。模型提取攻击是指攻击者通过大量查询目标模型，试图复制其知识或行为以构建替代模型。现有的防御措施要么在攻击发生后才采取行动（如事后检测），要么显著降低合法用户的模型效用（如输出扰动）。Knowledge Trap的核心理念是“主动诱捕”，而非被动阻断：它通过构建一个蜜罐知识图（Honeypot Knowledge Graph, HKG）和“面包屑”引导探索机制，将攻击者的查询引导至低可迁移性的虚假知识上，从而消耗其有限的查询预算，同时不影响合法用户的正常使用。具体而言，HKG包含精心设计的虚假但看似合理的事实关联，攻击者在试图提取真实知识时会被误导去探索这些无实际下游用途的知识路径，而合法用户通过正常的查询模式不会触发这些诱饵。实验在医疗和金融领域进行，结果显示，Knowledge Trap在不降低合法用户准确率的前提下，平均使攻击者的替代模型一致性（Agreement）降低了6.2%，优于现有会给用户带来可测量影响的防御方法。该研究为防御LLM提取攻击提供了一个新的方向，即通过保护知识空间遍历来消耗攻击者资源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种主动诱导而非被动阻断的防御思路，在不影响合法用户体验的前提下有效消耗攻击者预算，对保护商业LLMAPI的知识产权和安全性具有实际参考价值。

items.title: AttackonCTF: Defending Hardware Security Competition Benchmarks in the Age of LLMs
items.summary: Hardware security competitions such as HackTheSilicon serve as benchmarking platforms for evaluating vulnerability detection methods and for training humans and AI. However, our study reveals that LLMs threaten their validity. Instead of genuine security reasoning, detectors exploit a diff-style syntactic comparison, achieving an 83% detection rate, undermining fair evaluation. To mitigate this, we propose the first LLM-oriented, semantics-preserving obfuscation framework for these benchmarks. Unlike IP-protection approaches, it applies human-readable transformations and controlled diff-noise while preserving functionality. On HackTheSilicon, the framework reduces LLM-based detection accuracy by 50% with only 10% obfuscation and by 78.6% under complete obfuscation, restoring benchmark reliability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）对硬件安全竞赛基准测试平台的威胁。以HackTheSilicon为例，研究发现现有的漏洞检测方法并非基于真正的安全推理，而是利用了一种基于diff风格的语法比较技巧，从而实现了83%的检测成功率。这种投机取巧的行为破坏了基准测试的公平性和有效性，使得评估结果失真。为了应对这一问题，论文提出了首个面向LLM的、语义保持的混淆框架，旨在保护这些基准测试。与传统的IP保护方法不同，该框架在保持电路功能不变的前提下，应用人类可读的变换和受控的diff噪声。在HackTheSilicon基准上，实验表明：仅10%的混淆程度就能将LLM的检测准确率降低50%；在完全混淆下，准确率下降78.6%，从而有效恢复了基准测试的可靠性。该工作为硬件安全竞赛的公平评估提供了新思路，也为后续研究如何防御LLM对抗性攻击奠定了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前硬件安全基准测试中的重大缺陷，即LLM可利用表面特征而非真实漏洞知识取胜，这对评估安全工具的能力构成根本挑战。提出的混淆框架为恢复基准有效性提供了实用方案，能防止LLM作弊，确保竞赛和评估的公正性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响硬件安全竞赛（如HackTheSilicon）的公平性，进而影响基于此类基准的漏洞检测工具评估和人才培养。框架可推广到其他依赖静态比较的CTF或安全评测场景。

items.title: GAS-Leak-LLM: Genetic Algorithm-Based Suffix Optimization for Black-Box LLM Jailbreaking
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) constitute pivotal components within the AI-dominated information technology ecosystem. To mitigate risks associated with harmful or policy-violating outputs, commercial systems employ advanced alignment strategies and multi-layered content moderation mechanisms. Despite these safeguards, recent research has demonstrated that LLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial manipulation, particularly through jailbreaking and prompt injection techniques. In this work, we propose GAS-Leak-LLM a novel jailbreaking attack based on a genetic algorithm that systematically evolves adversarial suffix to bypass safety constraints. Operating in a strict black-box setting, our method requires no access to model parameters or internals, thereby reflecting realistic threat scenarios in deployed systems. Through the iterative application of selection, mutation, and crossover heuristics, the framework systematically explores the discrete prompt space to identify high-fitness adversarial suffixes. Empirical findings reveal critical shortcomings in existing safety enforcement mechanisms and confirm the effectiveness and practical viability of the proposed attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 GAS-Leak-LLM 的新型黑盒大语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击方法。该方法基于遗传算法，通过迭代进化对抗性后缀来绕过模型的安全约束。研究背景是：尽管当前商用 LLM 采用了对齐训练和内容审核等多层防御机制，但模型仍易受对抗性操控，尤其是越狱和提示注入攻击。核心创新在于将遗传算法的选择、变异和交叉启发式应用于离散提示空间搜索，以自动发现高适应度的对抗性后缀。该方法完全在黑盒设置下运行，无需访问模型参数或内部结构，因此更贴近实际部署中的威胁场景。实验结果表明，该方法能有效揭示现有安全机制的严重缺陷，证明了攻击的实际可行性和有效性。该研究对于理解 LLM 安全漏洞、评估现有防御手段以及开发更鲁棒的对齐策略具有重要参考价值。适合 LLM 安全研究人员、AI 系统开发者和防御方阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了一种无需模型内部信息的黑盒越狱攻击方法，揭示了当前 LLM 安全对齐的不足，对防御者评估和改进模型安全性具有警示意义。

items.title: Snyk VulnBench JS 1.0: Can LLMs Find the Same Bugs Twice?
items.summary: We ran 300 repeated vulnerability-finding scans to measure how repeatable agentic large language model (LLM) security review is on the same JavaScript code, prompt, and benchmark harness. The headline result is that LLM security findings were unevenly repeatable: reference-matched findings were stable, but extra model reports varied heavily from run to run. Across 250 model runs, 80 of 161 unique unmatched findings appeared in only one of five identical repetitions, while only 22 appeared in all five. By contrast, when Claude matched a Snyk Code reference finding, the behavior was much more stable: 134 of 158 unique reference-matched findings appeared in all five repetitions. The benchmark also shows complementarity. Models consistently found familiar, high-signal exploit shapes, and in one case surfaced a likely Snyk Code product gap. Snyk Code static application security testing (SAST) was deterministic and better at systematically enumerating repeated data-flow sinks. The results support combining agentic LLM review with deterministic SAST rather than treating either technique as a replacement for the other.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了基于智能体的大语言模型（LLM）在漏洞发现任务中的可重复性。作者使用相同的JavaScript代码、提示词和基准测试框架，进行了300次重复漏洞扫描，以衡量LLM安全审查结果的一致性。主要发现是LLM的漏洞发现结果不均匀可重复：当漏洞匹配Snyk Code参考发现时，行为相对稳定（158个唯一参考匹配发现中有134个在所有五次重复中出现）；但额外的模型报告（未匹配参考）变化很大，250次模型运行中，161个唯一未匹配发现中有80个仅在一次重复中出现，只有22个在所有五次重复中出现。基准测试还显示了互补性：模型能一致地发现常见的高信号利用模式，一次案例中甚至暴露了Snyk Code的产品缺口。相比之下，Snyk Code静态应用安全测试（SAST）是确定性的，更适合系统地枚举重复的数据流和sink。结论是，应结合使用智能体LLM审查和确定性SAST，而非将任一技术视为替代。该研究适合安全工程师、LLM应用开发者及DevSecOps从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示LLM在漏洞发现中的可重复性问题，为安全评估工具选型提供实证。

items.title: Odds Law: The Decomposition Algebra On How Intelligence Organizes Itself to Solve Difficult Problems Reliably
items.summary: We ask a structural question: given unreliable elementary problem-solvers, what organizations of them solve hard problems reliably, and what are the limits? We develop a $decomposition~algebra$: elementary solvers are morphisms in a stochastic category, and four combinators (sequential composition, parallel ensembling, verification gating, and recursive reduction) generate the space of compound solvers. We equip this algebra with two homomorphisms, a $reliability$ valuation into the ordered monoid $([0,1],\le)$ and a $cost$ valuation into a commutative semiring, and we derive the composition laws that govern how reliability flows through structure. Our central results are (i) a $verification~odds~law$ (the result that names this report), showing that a verification gate multiplies the odds of correctness by the verifier's likelihood ratio $Λ$, so that $k$ conditionally independent gates yield geometric amplification; (ii) a $reliability~amplification~theorem$, giving target reliability $1-δ$ at $O(\log 1/δ)$ verification depth whenever $Λ>1$; and (iii) a $threshold~dichotomy$: above the critical parameters reliability can be driven arbitrarily close to one at logarithmic cost, while at or below them no amplification is possible. We then show that $self-organization$ is the least fixed point of a monotone improvement operator on the complete lattice of strategies, and that this fixed point equalizes marginal log-odds gain per unit cost. Finally, we prove matching limits: an information ceiling bounds per-gate amplification by a divergence quantity; shared error causes create a strictly positive voting floor, so diversity is $necessary$ for unbounded amplification. Reliability, in short, is neither free nor magical: it is bought with independent information, arranged by composition, and bounded by the verifier.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了如何将不可靠的基本问题求解器组织成能够可靠解决困难问题的复合结构，并揭示了其理论极限。作者构建了一个“分解代数”（decomposition algebra）：将基本求解器视为随机范畴中的态射，并通过四个组合子——顺序组合、并行集成、验证门控和递归归约——生成所有可能的复合求解器空间。该代数配备了两个同态映射：一个将可靠性映射到有序幺半群([0,1],≤)中，另一个将成本映射到交换半环上，从而推导出可靠性在结构中流动的组合法则。核心结果包括：(i) 验证几率定理（Verification Odds Law）：验证门将正确几率乘以验证器的似然比Λ，k个条件独立的门可实现几何级放大；(ii) 可靠性放大定理：当Λ>1时，达到目标可靠性1-δ所需验证深度为O(log 1/δ)；(iii) 阈值二分法：在关键参数之上，可靠性可以以对数成本逼近1，而在阈值以下则不可能放大。此外，论文证明自组织是完备格上单调改进算子的最小不动点，该不动点使边际对数几率增益与单位成本相等。最后，作者证明了匹配的极限：每个门的放大受限于信息散度的信息上限；共享错误原因会导致严格正投票下限，因此多样性对于无界放大是必要的。总之，可靠性既非免费也非魔法，它需要通过独立信息、组合安排和验证器来获取。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为构建可靠的多智能体系统或安全代理提供了理论基础，尤其适用于需要高可靠性的安全场景，如自动化防御决策。定理表明验证器质量和多样性是关键，对设计安全Agent架构具有指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 潜在影响AI安全、多智能体协作、自动化渗透测试与防御、以及任何依赖不可靠组件构建可靠系统的领域。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为构建可靠的多智能体系统或安全代理提供了理论基础，尤其适用于需要高可靠性的安全场景，如自动化防御决策。定理表明验证器质量和多样性是关键，对设计安全Agent架构具有指导意义。

items.title: FragFuse: Bypassing Access Control of Large Language Model Agents via Memory-Based Query Fragmentation and Fusion
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support complex task execution, user personalization, and domain adaptation. Meanwhile, emerging access-control mechanisms for LLM agents are being explored to block policy-violating requests and prevent misuse. We reveal a novel attack surface arising from agent memory operations: prohibited content that would trigger access control can be fragmented across interactions, stored in long-term memory in benign-appearing form, and later reconstructed through memory retrieval without appearing explicitly in the final user query. We propose FragFuse, the first attack that enables unprivileged users to bypass agent access control by exploiting this temporal channel introduced by long-term memory. FragFuse operates in three stages: (1) identifying rejection-responsive fragments via black-box adaptive querying with fragment masking; (2) injecting these fragments into memory using marker carrier queries; and (3) retrieving and fusing the stored fragments through a follow-up attack query. Although FragFuse can be instantiated manually for individual agents, we further develop a surrogate-based optimization scheme that tunes fusion instructions and marker designs, enabling automated attack generation without violating the attacker's threat-model assumptions. We evaluate FragFuse across four representative agent settings and task domains, covering three state-of-the-art agent access-control mechanisms. FragFuse achieves an average bypass success rate of 86.3% and an average end-to-end harmful task success rate of 41.1% across all settings, with only 4.4% average task-success degradation compared with configurations without access control. We also show that alternative defenses, including state-of-the-art prompt-injection detectors and perplexity detectors, do not effectively address this attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次揭示了基于长期记忆的LLM代理系统中存在的新型攻击面。现有针对LLM代理的访问控制机制通常检查用户最终查询中的内容，以阻止违反策略的请求。然而，作者发现攻击者可以将禁止的内容在多次交互中分割成看似无害的片段，存储在长期记忆中，随后通过记忆检索重建，从而绕过访问控制。具体地，提出FragFuse攻击，分为三个阶段：（1）通过黑盒自适应查询和片段掩码识别触发拒绝的片段；（2）使用标记载体查询将这些片段注入记忆；（3）通过后续攻击查询检索并融合存储的片段。为了自动化攻击生成，进一步开发了基于替代模型的优化方案，调整融合指令和标记设计。在四个代表性代理设置和任务领域上评估了FragFuse，覆盖三种最先进的访问控制机制，平均绕过成功率为86.3%，端到端有害任务成功率为41.1%，相比无访问控制配置仅降低4.4%。此外，现有的提示注入检测器和困惑度检测器均无法有效防御此攻击。该工作揭示了长期记忆中存储与检索时序通道的脆弱性，对LLM代理安全设计和访问控制机制提出了新挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该攻击利用LLM代理长期记忆的时序特性，绕过当前主流的访问控制机制，成功率极高，对依赖长期记忆的LLM应用构成严重威胁，需要安全社区关注并开发新的防御策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用长期记忆的LLM代理系统，包括个人助手、代码生成代理、多轮对话系统等，特别是那些部署了基于内容过滤的访问控制的场景。攻击者可实现越权操作，如生成违禁内容、执行恶意代码等。

items.why_it_matters: 该攻击利用LLM代理长期记忆的时序特性，绕过当前主流的访问控制机制，成功率极高，对依赖长期记忆的LLM应用构成严重威胁，需要安全社区关注并开发新的防御策略。

items.title: CmdNeedle: Measuring the Incompleteness of Command Denylists for AI Agents
items.summary: The adoption of AI agents is increasing rapidly. Terminal AI agents, i.e., AI agents that run in terminal environments, are a widely used type of AI agents. Terminal AI agents rely heavily on shell command execution to interact with the host systems. They adopt a three-list command-gating mechanism to mitigate security risks introduced by command execution, with denylists serving as the load-bearing component. However, modern operating systems often ship a large, ever-expanding set of shell commands with complex functionalities. Our observation is that even a built-in denylist of Claude Code, well-maintained by its developers, can overlook bypass commands that invalidate its effectiveness. Such negligence leads to fragile command denylists that cannot even block operations that practitioners expect them to block. This paper presents the first systematic characterization of command denylist fragility in terminal AI agents. The paper formalizes the command denylist fragility problem and proposes an LLM-driven pipeline, CmdNeedle, to detect such fragility. It prompts the LLM to propose possible bypasses and iteratively repairs them using feedback from a validator that executes them in a sandbox. In the evaluation, we applied CmdNeedle to 1,709 real-world command denylists (containing 13,332 denylist rules) collected from GitHub. The evaluation shows several key findings, including that 69.0--98.6% of the denylists are fragile, that this fragility occurs consistently across projects and agents, and the validity of several possible root causes for this fragility. Our pipeline and findings will hopefully facilitate future research and practice regarding the command denylists used by AI agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对终端AI代理（Terminal AI Agents）中命令黑名单的不完备性问题进行了首次系统性研究。终端AI代理通过执行shell命令与主机系统交互，通常采用三列表命令门控机制（允许列表、拒绝列表、警告列表）来控制命令执行，其中拒绝列表（黑名单）是核心安全组件。然而，现代操作系统包含大量且不断增长的shell命令，功能复杂，即使是由开发者精心维护的Claude Code内置黑名单，也可能遗漏能够绕过其限制的命令，导致黑名单形同虚设。研究正式定义了命令黑名单脆弱性问题，即黑名单无法有效阻止预期禁止的操作。为此，作者提出了一种基于LLM驱动的自动化检测管线CmdNeedle，通过提示LLM生成潜在的绕过命令，并在沙盒中执行验证，迭代修复和补充黑名单规则。实验阶段，研究从GitHub收集了1,709个真实世界命令黑名单（包含13,332条规则），应用CmdNeedle进行评估。结果表明，69.0%-98.6%的黑名单存在脆弱性，这种现象在不同项目和代理间普遍存在，并分析了若干可能的根本原因。本文的管线与发现将为AI代理命令黑名单的未来研究和实践提供重要参考。适合AI安全研究人员、终端代理开发者、安全策略制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 终端AI代理的安全性高度依赖命令黑名单，但其不完备性可能被攻击者利用，导致权限提升或系统破坏。本文首次系统揭示了这一问题的严重程度，并为自动化检测和修补提供了方法。

items.why_it_matters: 终端AI代理的安全性高度依赖命令黑名单，但其不完备性可能被攻击者利用，导致权限提升或系统破坏。本文首次系统揭示了这一问题的严重程度，并为自动化检测和修补提供了方法。

items.title: Multi-tier Differential Private Query Release
items.summary: Answering statistical queries over sensitive data under differential privacy (DP) is a common task in many settings, including databases, mobile computing, and data markets. In these scenarios, multiple analysts may issue the same query, while receiving answers generated under different privacy budgets due to differences in trust levels or willingness to pay. Existing approaches for such multi-tier DP queries either incur excessive cumulative privacy loss or suffer from suboptimal utility. In this paper, we propose a framework for multi-tier DP query release that simultaneously bound the cumulative privacy loss by the maximum privacy budget among all queries and achieve optimal utility comparable to that of single-tier mechanisms. Our framework applies to different classes of DP mechanisms. For noise-adding mechanisms (e.g., count queries with the two-sided Geometric mechanism in the curator model), we develop a general solution based on the characteristic functions of noise distributions. For other mechanisms (e.g., count queries under the local DP model with the Subset mechanism), we design mechanism-specific primitives for budget transformation and introduce a template-based strategy that attains optimal utility across different privacy regimes. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对差分隐私下统计查询的多层级发布问题展开研究。在实际场景（如数据库、移动计算、数据市场）中，多个分析师可能对同一数据集发起相同的统计查询，但由于信任程度或支付意愿的差异，每个分析师收到的答案需满足不同的隐私预算。现有处理多层级差分隐私查询的方法要么造成过高的累积隐私损失，要么查询效用次优。为此，本文提出一种新型多层级差分隐私查询释放框架，能够同时实现两项关键目标：将累积隐私损失限制在所有查询的最大隐私预算内（而非累加），并使查询效用达到与单层机制相当的最优水平。该框架适用于不同类别的差分隐私机制。对于噪声添加机制（例如策展人模型中基于双侧几何机制的计数查询），作者开发了基于噪声分布特征函数的通用解法；对于其他机制（例如本地差分隐私模型下基于子集机制的计数查询），则设计了机制特定的预算转换原语，并引入一种模板化策略以实现不同隐私预算区间下的最优效用。实验结果表明，该框架在多种设置下均能有效控制隐私损失并提升查询精度。本文的主要贡献在于理论层面上推导了多层级差分隐私查询的隐私边界与效用下界，并提供了可实现的算法框架，对数据发布中的隐私保护实践具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了多用户不同隐私预算下查询发布的累积隐私损失问题，提出的框架使隐私消耗仅取决于最大预算，显著提升效用。安全从业者可借此优化数据共享与隐私保护策略，尤其适用于多方合作的数据市场或移动计算场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响差分隐私数据库系统、移动计算隐私协议及数据市场定价机制的设计，提升多用户差异化隐私保护下的数据可用性。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究解决了多用户不同隐私预算下查询发布的累积隐私损失问题，提出的框架使隐私消耗仅取决于最大预算，显著提升效用。安全从业者可借此优化数据共享与隐私保护策略，尤其适用于多方合作的数据市场或移动计算场景。

items.title: Greedy Coordinate Diffusion: Effective and Semantically Coherent Adversarial Attacks via Diffusion Guidance
items.summary: Fine-tuning aligned language models on benign tasks (e.g. math tutoring) systematically breaks safety guardrails, even when training data contains no harmful content. While mechanistic approaches have shed light on where alignment resides in model weights, they do not by provide a general formal framework for deriving guarantees about when fine-tuning degrades it -- leaving the field without principled tools for predicting or preventing alignment collapse. We develop a local geometric framework through geometric analysis of parameter-space trajectories and apply it to understand the fragility of alignment in fine-tuning. While first-order analysis suggests orthogonal updates are safe, we prove this is illusory: the curvature of the fine-tuning loss induces second-order acceleration that can induce second-order drift into alignment-sensitive regions. We formalize a construct of our framework as the Alignment Instability Condition (AIC), three geometric properties that, when present, are sufficient to guarantee degradation. Our main result proves quartic onset of alignment degradation along gradient-flow trajectories, determined by how sharply alignment depends on specific parameters and how strongly tasks couple to these parameters. These findings yield formal sufficient conditions under which static first-order protection can fail under gradient descent. We further empirically validate the framework's foundations, showing that the Fisher Information Matrix provides a proxy for the degree of safety degradation across diverse fine-tuning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究针对微调导致大语言模型安全对齐退化的问题，提出了一种局部几何分析框架。背景：即使训练数据不含任何有害内容，在数学辅导等良性任务上微调已对齐的语言模型也会系统性破坏安全护栏。现有机制方法虽揭示了安全对齐在模型权重中的位置，但缺乏通用的形式化框架来推导微调何时会退化对齐，导致缺乏预测或预防对齐崩溃的原则性工具。核心贡献：作者通过参数空间轨迹的几何分析，开发了局部几何框架。首先证明一阶分析认为正交更新是安全的这一直觉是虚假的：微调损失曲率会引发二阶加速，导致模型参数向对齐敏感区域产生二阶漂移。接着形式化定义了对齐不稳定条件（AIC），包含三个几何性质，当这些性质同时存在时，足以保证对齐退化发生。主要理论结果是证明了沿梯度流轨迹的对齐退化以四次方速度发生，其强度取决于对齐对特定参数的敏感度以及任务与这些参数的耦合强度。这些发现给出了静态一阶防护在梯度下降下失效的形式充分条件。实验验证了框架基础，表明Fisher信息矩阵可作为跨不同微调场景安全退化程度的代理指标。该工作为理解微调导致对齐崩溃提供了严格的几何解释，并为设计更鲁棒的对齐保持微调方法奠定了理论基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究从几何角度揭示了微调导致对齐退化的根本原因，给出了形式化条件预测防护失效，对LLM安全微调实践和防护机制设计具有重要理论指导价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于LLM安全对齐评估、微调安全防护设计、以及理解其他微调相关安全问题（如遗忘、偏见放大）。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究从几何角度揭示了微调导致对齐退化的根本原因，给出了形式化条件预测防护失效，对LLM安全微调实践和防护机制设计具有重要理论指导价值。

items.title: Model Stealing Through the Lens of Model Multiplicity
items.summary: Model stealing attacks, where adversaries create high-fidelity surrogate models, are a significant threat to the intellectual property of machine learning services. Conventional wisdom suggests these surrogates could provide adversaries with economic leverage comparable to the original service providers. This paper challenges this assumption by evaluating model stealing attacks beyond mere fidelity to the target model. Because query-based extraction provides only partial supervision of the target's input-output behavior, the surrogate is not uniquely identified: many near-optimal surrogates can achieve comparable fidelity while differing in deployment-relevant properties. Instead of performing a classic learning-based model stealing attack, we compute the Rashomon Set (i.e., the set of almost-equally-accurate models) of surrogate models, and evaluate its diversity using multiplicity metrics (ambiguity, discrepancy, and Rashomon Capacity) and group fairness metrics. Across tabular, medical imaging, and NLP tasks, our experiments on real-world datasets reveal that despite exhibiting similar fidelity to the target model, surrogate models can display significant variances in other critical performance metrics. These findings cast doubt on the presumed equivalence between high-fidelity surrogates and the target model in practical deployment scenarios.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文挑战了关于模型窃取攻击的传统认知：即攻击者通过构建高保真代理模型便能获得与原始模型提供者相当的经济优势。作者指出，由于基于查询的提取只能部分监督目标模型的输入-输出行为，代理模型并非唯一确定；实际上存在一个“Rashomon Set” —— 由许多近乎等精度的模型组成，它们在部署相关属性上存在显著差异。为了量化这种多样性，作者引入了多重性指标（歧义性、不一致性、Rashomon 容量）以及群体公平性指标。实验涵盖表格数据、医学影像和自然语言处理任务，使用真实数据集。结果表明，尽管代理模型与目标模型在保真度上相似，但在其他关键性能指标（如公平性、鲁棒性等）上可能存在巨大差异。这一发现质疑了高保真代理模型在实际部署中与目标模型等价的假设。论文核心贡献在于从模型多样性视角重新评估模型窃取攻击的危害，为模型知识产权保护提供了新的理论依据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 挑战了模型窃取攻击中'高保真即等同'的常见假设，提醒安全从业者在评估模型泄露风险时需考虑代理模型的多重性质，而非仅关注保真度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响模型知识产权评估、模型窃取攻击的危害度量，以及防御策略的设计——可能需要关注代理模型的多样性而非单一保真度。

items.why_it_matters: 挑战了模型窃取攻击中'高保真即等同'的常见假设，提醒安全从业者在评估模型泄露风险时需考虑代理模型的多重性质，而非仅关注保真度。

items.title: In-DRAM Signature Generation Using Simultaneous Multiple-Row Activation: An Experimental Study of Off-The-Shelf DRAM Chips
items.summary: We experimentally demonstrate that it is possible to generate unique, repeatable, and device-specific signatures suitable for use as Physical Unclonable Function (PUF) responses in commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) DRAM chips by leveraging simultaneous multiple-row activation (SiMRA). Based on a rigorous experimental characterization of 112 modern DDR4 DRAM chips (from 10 modules), we introduce SiMRA-PUF, the first DRAM-based PUF that uses SiMRA-generated signatures as PUF responses. We analyze SiMRA-PUF in terms of reliability, uniqueness, and evaluation latency for varying numbers of simultaneously activated DRAM rows (i.e., 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32), DRAM chip density & die revision, and evaluate how temperature affects the similarity of SiMRA-generated responses. Among our 8 key experimental observations, we highlight two major results. First, SiMRA-PUF provides average intra-Jaccard indices of 89.02%, 89.81%, 93.03%, 94.06%, and 94.86%, and average inter-Jaccard indices of 3.98%, 2.37%, 3.44%, 2.92%, and 3.24% for 2-, 4-, 8-, 16-, and 32-row activations, respectively, showing that SiMRA-generated signatures are both repeatable within a device and unique across devices. Second, 2-row activation-based SiMRA-PUF provides 5.75% lower evaluation latency than the state-of-the-art DRAM-based PUF. We open-source our infrastructure and datasets at https://github.com/CMU-SAFARI/SiMRA-PUF.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文实验性展示了在商用现货（COTS）DRAM芯片中，利用同时多行激活（SiMRA）技术可以生成唯一、可重复且设备特定的签名，适用于物理不可克隆函数（PUF）响应。作者对来自10个内存模块的112个现代DDR4 DRAM芯片进行了严格实验表征，提出了SiMRA-PUF，这是首个使用SiMRA生成签名作为PUF响应的DRAM基PUF。研究分析了SiMRA-PUF在不同同时激活行数（2、4、8、16、32行）、DRAM芯片密度和版本下的可靠性、唯一性和评估延迟，并评估了温度对SiMRA生成响应相似性的影响。主要实验发现：SiMRA-PUF在2、4、8、16、32行激活下的平均类内Jaccard指数分别为89.02%、89.81%、93.03%、94.06%和94.86%，平均类间Jaccard指数分别为3.98%、2.37%、3.44%、2.92%和3.24%，表明签名在设备内部可重复且跨设备唯一。2行激活的SiMRA-PUF比现有最先进的DRAM基PUF评估延迟低5.75%。作者已开源基础设施和数据集。该工作为利用DRAM固有物理特性实现低成本硬件安全原语提供了新途径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提供了一种利用商用DRAM芯片生成唯一物理指纹的新方法，不依赖专用硬件，对硬件安全领域（如物联网设备身份认证、密钥存储）有潜在应用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何使用标准DRAM的系统（如服务器、PC、嵌入式设备），提供基于物理特性的设备身份认证或密钥生成，但对实际部署的鲁棒性和抗攻击能力还需进一步验证。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估SiMRA-PUF在内部硬件安全方案中的可行性。

items.title: The Audit Gap in Blockchain Security: A Four-Year Empirical Study of Public Audit Findings and Real-World Exploit Incidents
items.summary: This paper presents an empirical analysis of the Web3 security landscape over the four-year and three-month period from 1 January 2022 to 27 March 2026. The dataset combines 23,818 public audit findings produced by 22 independent security firms with 218 real-world exploit incidents documented by rekt.news, representing aggregate losses of approximately US$7.76 billion. We report three central findings. First, the distribution of audit findings (by severity, category, and technology stack) is substantially stable across the observation window, with the Critical-plus-High share remaining within a 15-17% band in every complete year. Second, the categorical distribution of realised exploit losses does not correspond to the categorical distribution of audit findings: private-key compromise, phishing, and social-engineering vectors account for approximately 49.6% of cumulative losses yet represent a negligible share of published audit findings. Third, realised losses exhibit extreme concentration: the eight largest incidents account for 50.6% of cumulative dollar losses and the twenty largest for 71.4%, a distributional shape inconsistent with Gaussian assumptions. Throughout, we adopt the analytical convention that audit outputs and exploit outputs describe different populations and present the two datasets in parallel rather than as directly comparable samples.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对2022年1月1日至2026年3月27日期间（四年三个月）的Web3安全格局进行了实证分析。数据集包含22家独立安全公司发布的23,818份公开审计结果，以及rekt.news记录的218起真实世界漏洞事件，累计损失约77.6亿美元。研究有三个核心发现：第一，审计发现的分布（按严重性、类别和技术栈）在观察窗口内基本稳定，严重加高危比例每年保持在15-17%区间；第二，实际漏洞损失的类别分布与审计发现的类别分布不一致：私钥泄露、钓鱼和社会工程攻击向量占累计损失的约49.6%，但在公开审计发现中占比极小；第三，实际损失呈现极端集中现象：前八大事件占累计美元损失的50.6%，前二十大占71.4%，这种分布形态不符合高斯假设。研究采用的分析惯例是：审计输出和漏洞输出描述的是不同总体，因此将两个数据集并行呈现而非直接比较。该论文适合区块链安全研究人员、审计公司、安全分析师以及关注Web3风险管理的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了区块链审计与实际漏洞损失之间的显著差距，说明当前审计实践未能有效覆盖高损失攻击向量（如私钥泄露、社会工程），对安全投资和审计策略制定具有重要指导意义。

items.title: Defending against Adaptive Prompt Injection Attacks via Reasoning-enabled Task Alignment
items.summary: Indirect prompt injection attacks hijack LLM-based agents by embedding malicious instructions in third-party data that the agent retrieves during task execution. Existing defenses report near-zero attack success rate on static benchmarks, yet recent adaptive evaluations show that these results collapse once the attacker is allowed to optimize against the deployed defense. In this work, we trace this collapse to two failure modes. First, existing defense methods are confined to recognizing specific attack patterns, rather than assessing whether the intent of every embedded instruction is relevant to the user task. Second, training-based defenses, which otherwise offer the strongest safety-utility trade-off, assemble their adversarial examples from a handful of hand-crafted templates, and the resulting defender fails to generalize outside that narrow strategy distribution. To address these gaps, we propose RETA, a training-based method that grounds defense decisions on the user tasks rather than attacker-controlled data. At each tool-output step, the defender undertakes chain-of-thought reasoning verifying that its actions are consistent with the user task. Leveraging red-teaming, a simulated attacker synthesizes adversarial training data and receives a dictionary-learning diversity reward, achieving broad coverage of injection-reformulation strategies. Together, these allow the defender to be optimized via multi-objective reinforcement learning and achieve better safety-utility trade-off. Across six black-box adaptive attacks, RETA keeps every per-attack ASR below 10%, with average ASR of 2.92% and 3.75% on the two target models, while preserving most utility under attack and on clean inputs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对LLM代理面临的间接提示注入攻击——攻击者通过在代理检索的第三方数据中嵌入恶意指令来劫持代理——提出了新的防御方法。现有防御在静态基准测试中报告接近零的攻击成功率，但最近的自适应评估表明，一旦攻击者被允许针对部署的防御进行优化，这些结果就会失效。作者将这一失效归因于两个失败模式：首先，现有防御方法局限于识别特定攻击模式，而非评估每个嵌入指令的意图是否与用户任务相关；其次，基于训练的防御虽然通常提供最强的安全-效用均衡，但其对抗示例来自少数手工制作的模板，导致防御者无法泛化到该狭窄策略分布之外。为解决这些问题，本文提出RETA（基于推理的任务对齐防御），这是一种基于训练的方法，将防御决策基于用户任务而非攻击者控制的数据。在每个工具输出步骤，防御者进行链式思维推理，验证其动作与用户任务一致。利用红队测试，模拟攻击者合成对抗性训练数据并接收字典学习多样性奖励，实现了注入改写策略的广泛覆盖。这些设计允许通过多目标强化学习优化防御者，取得更好的安全-效用均衡。在六种黑盒自适应攻击下，RETA将每次攻击的成功率（ASR）保持在10%以下，在两个目标模型上平均ASR分别为2.92%和3.75%，同时在攻击和干净输入下保持了大部分效用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统分析了自适应提示注入攻击下现有防御的失效原因，并提出了基于任务对齐的推理式防御方法，显著提升了LLM代理在实际部署中的鲁棒性，对安全从业者设计更可靠的AI系统具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有依赖外部数据检索的LLM代理系统（如RAG、工具调用），可迁移至智能客服、自动化工作流等场景，减少注入攻击导致的信息泄露或非预期操作。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究首次系统分析了自适应提示注入攻击下现有防御的失效原因，并提出了基于任务对齐的推理式防御方法，显著提升了LLM代理在实际部署中的鲁棒性，对安全从业者设计更可靠的AI系统具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Benign in Isolation, Harmful in Composition: Security Risks in Agent Skill Ecosystems
items.summary: Skills are becoming the capability layer through which LLM agents turn plans into actions, but their use introduces security risks such as data leakage, unauthorized operations, and tool misuse. Existing vetting usually evaluates each skill in isolation, while real agent tasks often invoke multiple skills in a shared execution context. This creates Skill Composition Risk (SCR): a skill that appears benign alone can become harmful when its outputs, trust signals, authorization cues, or side effects influence later invocations along an activated path. We introduce SCR-Bench to evaluate this risk in controlled, sandboxed skill environments. Rather than relying only on textual intent or surface behavior, SCR-Bench records downstream state changes and path-level outcomes across composed skill executions. It contains three sub-benchmarks: SCR-CapFlow for capability-flow composition, SCR-TrustLift for trust-transfer composition, and SCR-AuthBlur for authorization-confusion composition. Across SCR-Bench, composed paths expose risks that are largely absent under isolated evaluation. In SCR-CapFlow, attack success rate reaches 33.6 percent under composition, compared with near-zero isolated baselines. In SCR-TrustLift, attack success rate exceeds 96.5 percent on four of five backends. In SCR-AuthBlur, the risky-approval rate increases by 71.8 percent relative to the L0 isolated baseline under the L1 context setting. These results show that agent skill security should be assessed at the level of activated paths rather than isolated artifacts. SCR and SCR-Bench provide a foundation for path-aware risk evaluation and defense in LLM agent skill ecosystems. Benchmark: https://github.com/saint-viperx/SCR_Bench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）智能体技能生态系统中存在的组合安全风险。智能体技能作为能力层，使LLM能够将计划转化为具体行动，但其使用可能引发数据泄露、未授权操作和工具滥用等安全问题。现有安全审查通常对每个技能进行独立评估，但实际智能体任务往往在共享执行上下文中调用多个技能。这导致一种新型风险——技能组合风险（SCR）：单独看似无害的技能，当其输出、信任信号、授权线索或副作用沿激活路径影响后续调用时，可能变得有害。为系统评估此类风险，作者提出SCR-Bench基准，在受控沙盒技能环境中测量下游状态变化和路径级结果。SCR-Bench包含三个子基准：SCR-CapFlow（能力流组合）、SCR-TrustLift（信任传递组合）和SCR-AuthBlur（授权混淆组合）。实验表明，组合路径暴露的风险在独立评估中基本不存在。具体结果：SCR-CapFlow中组合攻击成功率达33.6%（独立基线接近0%）；SCR-TrustLift中五个后端有四个攻击成功率超过96.5%；SCR-AuthBlur中风险批准率相比L0独立基线在L1上下文设置下提升71.8%。结果表明智能体技能安全应基于激活路径而非孤立项目进行评估。该工作为路径感知的风险评估与防御奠定了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示LLM智能体技能组合可能引入隐藏安全风险，挑战现有独立审查范式，对AI agent安全评估体系设计具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM agent安全评估方法论，可迁移至任何多技能协作的AI系统（如智能助手、自动化工作流）的安全审计场景。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示LLM智能体技能组合可能引入隐藏安全风险，挑战现有独立审查范式，对AI agent安全评估体系设计具有重要指导意义。

items.title: LLM: LSTM Look-Ahead Moving Target Defense Based on Historical Malicious Scan
items.summary: Network scanning is a critical preliminary step for most adversaries to gain essential information before launching cyber attacks. Moving Target Defense (MTD) based on IP shuffling has emerged as a proactive defense strategy to counteract these reconnaissance efforts. Unlike static, reactive defense techniques, IP shuffling introduces randomness by dynamically reassigning network addresses, making it more challenging for attackers to identify and track targets. However, current IP shuffling methods face three key challenges: 1) limited scalability across different network topologies, 2) inherent reconfiguration overhead even in the absence of an active attack, and 3) the need for large-scale unused address blocks. To address these issues, we propose LSTM Look-ahead Moving Target Defense (LLM). Our approach is the first attempt using a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to predict future target addresses that attackers will likely scan. Ensemble learning is used to improve robustness to different scanning behaviors. We introduce a dynamic mutation mechanism to enhance adaptability. Compared to the baseline mutation strategy, LLM performs better in both security and overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于LSTM（长短期记忆网络）的主动移动目标防御（MTD）方法，称为LLM（LSTM Look-ahead Moving Target Defense）。网络扫描是攻击者在发动攻击前获取目标信息的关键步骤。传统基于IP地址随机化的MTD策略虽然能有效对抗侦察，但存在三个主要问题：1) 难以扩展到不同网络拓扑；2) 即使没有攻击也会产生重配置开销；3) 需要大量未使用的地址块。LLM方法首次利用LSTM网络预测攻击者未来可能扫描的目标地址，从而提前改变IP地址，实现前瞻性防御。引入集成学习以增强对不同扫描行为的鲁棒性，同时设计动态变异机制以提高适应性。实验表明，与基线变异策略相比，LLM在安全性和开销方面均表现更优。该方法适用于需要保护网络免受扫描侦察的场景，尤其适合动态IP分配环境。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究利用时序预测模型主动应对网络扫描，为MTD提供了新思路，有望降低防御开销并提升对未知扫描模式的适应性。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究利用时序预测模型主动应对网络扫描，为MTD提供了新思路，有望降低防御开销并提升对未知扫描模式的适应性。

items.title: Robust and Precise Application Fingerprinting on 5G Physical Uplink Channel
items.summary: Air fingerprinting infers application activity by sniffing metadata from cellular control channels. 5G encrypts these channels, breaking the attack chain that prior attacks depend on. This paper reveals a physical-layer side channel that bypasses encryption: under the link adaptation mandated by the cellular communication standard, the uplink Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) remains stable, so the number of Physical Resource Blocks (PRBs) occupied by a transmission accurately reflects the IP packet length. Combined with the uplink control channel that carries downlink information, an attacker can reconstruct a bidirectional traffic profile. This bidirectional information recovery can be achieved simply by observing the uplink spectrum, without decoding any channel. Building on this side channel, we design Crosshair, a passive three-step attack. First, a blind extraction stage recovers the uplink physical channel occupancy from raw IQ samples via energy detection, reconstructing bidirectional traffic from uplink spectrum. Second, we design a data augmentation method that synthesizes spectral profiles across diverse channel conditions, eliminating the need for prior knowledge of the communication environment. Third, cross-modal alignment embeds the spectral and IP domains into a shared space, enabling new applications to be enrolled from a collected IP trace alone. Extensive experiments on a 5G NR testbed demonstrate the robustness and precision of Crosshair: it outperforms the State-of-the-Art (SOTA) physical layer fingerprinting method in application recognition accuracy, and maintains high accuracy in cross-MCS scenarios.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 传统的空中指纹识别（air fingerprinting）通过嗅探蜂窝控制信道元数据来推断应用活动，但5G对这些信道进行了加密，打破了先前攻击所依赖的攻击链。本文揭示了一种绕过加密的物理层侧信道：在蜂窝通信标准强制要求的链路自适应机制下，上行链路调制与编码方案（MCS）保持稳定，因此传输所占用的物理资源块（PRB）数量能够准确反映IP数据包长度。结合承载下行信息的上行控制信道，攻击者可以重构双向流量概况。这种双向信息恢复仅通过观测上行频谱即可实现，无需解码任何信道。基于该侧信道，本文设计了Crosshair，一种被动的三步攻击：第一步，盲提取阶段通过能量检测从原始IQ样本中恢复上行物理信道占用情况，进而从上行频谱重构双向流量；第二步，设计了一种数据增强方法，合成不同信道条件下的频谱轮廓，无需预先了解通信环境；第三步，跨模态对齐将频谱域和IP域嵌入到共享空间中，使得仅从采集的IP轨迹即可注册新应用。在5G NR测试床上进行的大量实验证明了Crosshair的鲁棒性和精确性：它在应用识别准确率上超越了现有的最先进物理层指纹识别方法，并在跨MCS场景下保持高准确率。该研究揭示了5G物理层的新侧信道，对用户隐私和无线网络安全构成潜在威胁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次发现5G物理层侧信道，可在不解码的情况下重构双向流量，突破加密保护，对用户隐私和网络监控形成新威胁，蓝队需了解该攻击原理以制定防护策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响5G用户隐私，可能被用于流量分析、应用识别及恶意监控，甚至绕过加密实施网络侦查。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 关注该攻击的后续发展，评估自身5G网络环境中的物理层侧信道暴露风险，考虑引入随机化或观测扰动等防御措施。

items.title: Attribute Inference from Interactive Targeted Ads
items.summary: Targeted advertising systems can pair audiences selected by advertisers with ad units that expose visible user actions. When an interaction remains linked to the campaign that elicited it, the advertiser may receive an observation tied to a user rather than only an aggregate report. We model that channel as a noisy oracle for attribute inference. The model separates targeting predicates, exposure, interaction, and disclosure. These boundaries capture the gap between eligibility and delivery, and the gap between interaction and advertiser visibility. We build a reproducible benchmark using synthetic populations calibrated with public data, each with known sensitive labels. A generated campaign semantics layer provides topic variants and response priors. The simulator generates the ground truth, event traces, disclosed observations, and metrics. The evaluation compares Bayesian, supervised, positive and unlabeled, and adaptive attacks under common campaign and disclosure definitions. The final evaluation uses four topic variants, seven simulator seeds, and two interaction settings. Repeated campaigns with identity exposure produce measurable but bounded inference signal. At $160$ campaigns, Bayesian and supervised attacks reach about $0.64$ AUC in the main setting and about $0.65$ AUC in the higher interaction setting. Disclosure policy is the strongest control. Aggregate reporting removes the evaluated oracle input tied to users. Type filtering and randomized disclosure reduce the released signal. The result is a model, artifact, and defense evaluation method for privacy in interactive targeted advertising. The code is available at https://github.com/P-HOW/Interactive-Ad-Oracle.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究交互式定向广告系统中的属性推断攻击。广告商通过定向广告系统可以选择特定用户群体，并将广告单元与可见的用户互动暴露相结合。当用户互动仍与引发该互动的广告活动关联时，广告商可能收到与用户个体相关的观测数据，而不仅仅是聚合报告。作者将此渠道建模为用于属性推断的带噪预言机，模型分离了定向谓词、曝光、互动和披露四个边界，捕捉了资格与交付之间的差距以及互动与广告商可见性之间的差距。论文使用合成人口数据（基于公开数据校准且带有已知敏感标签）构建了可复现的基准测试。一个生成的广告活动语义层提供主题变体和响应先验。模拟器生成真实标签、事件轨迹、披露观测数据和指标。评估比较了贝叶斯、监督式、正例-无标签以及自适应攻击在常见广告活动和披露定义下的表现。最终评估使用了四个主题变体、七个模拟器种子和两种互动设置。结果显示，重复的带有身份暴露的广告活动会产生可测量但有限的推断信号。在160个广告活动后，贝叶斯和监督式攻击在主设置中达到约0.64 AUC，在高互动设置中达到约0.65 AUC。披露策略是最强的控制手段：聚合报告移除与用户关联的评估预言机输入，类型过滤和随机化披露可减少释放的信号。论文最后提出了交互式定向广告中隐私问题的模型、工具和防御评估方法。代码已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了定向广告系统中用户属性被推断的风险，为广告生态系统的隐私评估提供了可量化的方法论和防御策略参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响广告行业的数据隐私合规和用户画像保护，可迁移至任何包含用户互动暴露的个性化推荐或定向投放场景。
